## Purpose

What problem does this solve? Name the existing feature ID; link an issue if there is one.

## Changes

Describe the resulting behavior or documentation correction.

## Validation

List the commands/checks you ran and their results. State anything not run and why.
For UI changes, use screenshots with fictional data.

## Impact

Note API/data compatibility, security, tenant isolation or deployment effects when relevant.
Small documentation corrections can say “none”.
